verses.en: O hearken, ye elders of my church, and give ear to the words which I shall speak unto you.
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia, outou toeaina o la’u ekalesia, ma uai mai o outou taliga i upu o le a Ou tautala atu ai ia te outou.

verses.en: For behold, verily, verily, I say unto you, that ye have received a commandment for a law unto my church, through him whom I have appointed unto you to receive commandments and revelations from my hand.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua outou maua se poloaiga mo se tulafono i la’u ekalesia, e ala atu ia te ia o lē na Ou tofi atu ia te outou na te mauaina poloaiga ma faaaliga mai lo’u lima.

verses.en: And this ye shall know assuredly—that there is none other appointed unto you to receive commandments and revelations until he be taken, if he abide in me.
verses.sm: Ma o le mea lenei ia outou iloa ma le mautinoa— e leai se isi e ese mai ua tofia atu ia te outou na te mauaina poloaiga ma faaaliga seia oo ina aveesea o ia, pe afai e tu mau o ia ia te a’u.

verses.en: But verily, verily, I say unto you, that none else shall be appointed unto this gift except it be through him; for if it be taken from him he shall not have power except to appoint another in his stead.
verses.sm: Ae e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e leai se isi e tofia i lenei meaalofa vagana ai ua ala mai ia te ia; aua afai e aveesea mai ia te ia, o le a leai se mana e ia te ia nao le tofia o se isi tagata i lona tulaga.

verses.en: And this shall be a law unto you, that ye receive not the teachings of any that shall come before you as revelations or commandments;
verses.sm: Ma ia avea lenei mea o se tulafono ia te outou, ia outou lē taliaina aoaoga a soo se tasi e sau i o outou luma, o ni faaaliga po o ni poloaiga;

verses.en: And this I give unto you that you may not be deceived, that you may know they are not of me.
verses.sm: Ma ua Ou tuu atu ia te outou lenei mea ina ia lē faaseseina outou, ina ia outou iloa ua lē mai ia te a’u i latou.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, that he that is ordained of me shall come in at the gate and be ordained as I have told you before, to teach those revelations which you have received and shall receive through him whom I have appointed.
verses.sm: Aua e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o ia o lē ua Ou faauuina, e sau i totonu e ala mai i le faitotoa ma faauuina e pei ona Ou ta’u atu muamua ia te outou, e aoao atu faaaliga na ua outou mauaina ma o le a outou mauaina e ala atu ia te ia o lē ua Ou tofia.

verses.en: And now, behold, I give unto you a commandment, that when ye are assembled together ye shall instruct and edify each other, that ye may know how to act and direct my church, how to act upon the points of my law and commandments, which I have given.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, a outou faapotopoto faatasi, ia outou aoao ma faagaeetia le tasi i le isi, ina ia outou iloa le ala tou te faia ma taitai ai la’u ekalesia, le ala tou te faia ai e faatatau i mataupu o la’u tulafono ma poloaiga, ia ua uma ona Ou tuuina atu.

verses.en: And thus ye shall become instructed in the law of my church, and be sanctified by that which ye have received, and ye shall bind yourselves to act in all holiness before me—
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapea ona aoaoina ai outou i le tulafono o la’u ekalesia, ma faapaiaina ai i mea na ua outou mauaina, ma ia outou fusia faatasi ai outou lava ia outou faia ma le paia atoatoa i o’u luma—

verses.en: That inasmuch as ye do this, glory shall be added to the kingdom which ye have received. Inasmuch as ye do it not, it shall be taken, even that which ye have received.
verses.sm: Ina ia tusa ai ma lo outou faia o lenei mea, o le a faaopoopo ai le mamalu i le malo ua outou maua. E tusa ai ma lo outou lē faia o lea mea, o le a ’aveesea ai, e oo lava i mea ua outou maua.

verses.en: Purge ye out the iniquity which is among you; sanctify yourselves before me;
verses.sm: Ia outou faamama ese le amioletonu ua i ai i totonu o outou; ia outou faapaia outou lava i o’u luma;

verses.en: And if ye desire the glories of the kingdom, appoint ye my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., and uphold him before me by the prayer of faith.
verses.sm: Ma afai tou te mananao i mamalu o le malo, ia outou tofia la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma lagolago o ia i o’u luma e ala i le tatalo o le faatuatua.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, that if ye desire the mysteries of the kingdom, provide for him food and raiment, and whatsoever thing he needeth to accomplish the work wherewith I have commanded him;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai tou te mananao i mealilo o le malo, tuu atu ia te ia meaai ma ofu, ma soo se mea e manaomia e ia e faataunuu ai le galuega ua Ou poloaiina ai o ia;

verses.en: And if ye do it not he shall remain unto them that have received him, that I may reserve unto myself a pure people before me.
verses.sm: Ma afai tou te lē faia o le a tumau pea o ia ia te i latou o e ua latou taliaina o ia, ina ia mafai ona Ou faasaoina mo a’u lava se nuu mama i o’u luma.

verses.en: Again I say, hearken ye elders of my church, whom I have appointed: Ye are not sent forth to be taught, but to teach the children of men the things which I have put into your hands by the power of my Spirit;
verses.sm: Ou te toe fai atu, faalogo mai ia outou toeaina o la’u ekalesia, o e ua Ou tofia: Ua lē auina atu outou ia aoaoina, ae ia aoao atu i le fanauga a tagata mea ua Ou tuu atu i o outou lima e ala i le mana o lo’u Agaga;

verses.en: And ye are to be taught from on high. Sanctify yourselves and ye shall be endowed with power, that ye may give even as I have spoken.
verses.sm: Ma o le a aoaoina outou mai luga. Ia outou faapaia outou lava ma o le a faaeeina outou i le mana, ina ia mafai ona outou tuuina atu e pei lava ona Ou tautala atu ai.

verses.en: Hearken ye, for, behold, the great day of the Lord is nigh at hand.
verses.sm: Ia outou faalogo mai, aua, faauta, ua lata mai ona oo mai le aso tele o le Alii.

verses.en: For the day cometh that the Lord shall utter his voice out of heaven; the heavens shall shake and the earth shall tremble, and the trump of God shall sound both long and loud, and shall say to the sleeping nations: Ye saints arise and live; ye sinners stay and sleep until I shall call again.
verses.sm: Aua e oo mai le aso o le a tulei mai ai e le Alii lona siufofoga mai le lagi; o le a luluina le lagi ma o le a gatete le lalolagi, ma o le a umi ma leotele le iliga o le pu a le Atua, ma o le a fai atu i atunuu momoe: Outou le au paia e ia tutulai mai ia ma ola; outou e ua agasala ia nonofo ma momoe pea seia Ou toe valaau atu.

verses.en: Wherefore gird up your loins lest ye be found among the wicked.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ia fusi i o outou sulugatiti ne’i maua outou i totonu o e ua amioleaga.

verses.en: Lift up your voices and spare not. Call upon the nations to repent, both old and young, both bond and free, saying: Prepare yourselves for the great day of the Lord;
verses.sm: Siitia a’e i luga o outou leo ma lē taofia. Valaau atu i atunuu ia salamo, o e matutua ma e talavou, o e pologa ma e saoloto, ia fai atu: Ia outou saunia outou lava mo le aso tele o le Alii;

verses.en: For if I, who am a man, do lift up my voice and call upon you to repent, and ye hate me, what will ye say when the day cometh when the thunders shall utter their voices from the ends of the earth, speaking to the ears of all that live, saying—Repent, and prepare for the great day of the Lord?
verses.sm: Aua afai e siitia a’e e a’u, o se tagata, lo’u leo i luga ma valaau atu ia te outou ia salamo, ae outou inoino mai ia te a’u, o le a se mea tou te fai mai pe a oo mai le aso o le a taalilili mai ai leo o faititili mai tuluiga o le lalolagi, e tautala mai i taliga o e uma e ola, fai mai— Ia salamo, ma sauni mo le aso tele o le Alii?

verses.en: Yea, and again, when the lightnings shall streak forth from the east unto the west, and shall utter forth their voices unto all that live, and make the ears of all tingle that hear, saying these words—Repent ye, for the great day of the Lord is come?
verses.sm: Ioe, o lenei foi, pe a feemo ane uila mai sasa’e i sisifo, ma lologo atu o latou leo i e uma e ola, ma faia ia ī taliga o e uma e faalogoina, ma fai atu upu nei— Ia outou salamo, ona ua oo mai le aso tele o le Alii?

verses.en: And again, the Lord shall utter his voice out of heaven, saying: Hearken, O ye nations of the earth, and hear the words of that God who made you.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le a tulei mai e le Alii lona siufofoga mai le lagi, fai mai: Faalogo mai ia, outou e atunuu o le lalolagi, ma faalogo mai i fetalaiga a le Atua lena o lē na faia outou.

verses.en: O, ye nations of the earth, how often would I have gathered you together as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, but ye would not!
verses.sm: E, outou e atunuu o le lalolagi, ua faafia ona po ua Ou faapotopotoina faatasi o outou e pei ona ofaofatai e se matuamoa lana toloai i lalo o ona apaau, ae outou lē mananao i ai!

verses.en: How oft have I called upon you by the mouth of my servants, and by the ministering of angels, and by mine own voice, and by the voice of thunderings, and by the voice of lightnings, and by the voice of tempests, and by the voice of earthquakes, and great hailstorms, and by the voice of famines and pestilences of every kind, and by the great sound of a trump, and by the voice of judgment, and by the voice of mercy all the day long, and by the voice of glory and honor and the riches of eternal life, and would have saved you with an everlasting salvation, but ye would not!
verses.sm: Ua faafia ona Ou valaau atu ia te outou e ala i fofoga o a’u auauna, ma i auaunaga a agelu, ma i lo’u lava leo, ma i le leo o faititili, ma i le leo o uila, ma i le leo o afā, ma i le leo o mafuie, ma uato’a tetele, ma i le leo o oge ma ituaiga o faamai eseese, ma i le leo tele o se pu, ma i le leo o le faamasinoga, ma i le leo o le alofa mutimutivale i le aso atoa, ma i le leo o le viiga ma le mamalu ma oa o le ola e faavavau, ma po ua Ou faaolaina outou i le olataga e faavavau, ae outou lē mananao i ai!

verses.en: Behold, the day has come, when the cup of the wrath of mine indignation is full.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua oo mai le aso, ua tumu ai le ipu o le sauā o lo’u ita.

verses.en: Behold, verily I say unto you, that these are the words of the Lord your God.
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o afioga nei a le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: Wherefore, labor ye, labor ye in my vineyard for the last time—for the last time call upon the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia outou galulue, ia outou galulue i lo’u tovine mo le taimi mulimuli— ona o le taimi mulimuli e valaau atu ai i e o nonofo i le lalolagi.

verses.en: For in mine own due time will I come upon the earth in judgment, and my people shall be redeemed and shall reign with me on earth.
verses.sm: Aua o le a Ou alu atu i lo’u lava taimi e tatau ai i luga o le lalolagi i le faamasinoga, ma o le a togiolaina lo’u nuu ma o le a nonofotupu faatasi ma a’u i luga o le lalolagi.

w.en: in my in mine own time

verses.en: For the great Millennium, of which I have spoken by the mouth of my servants, shall come.
verses.sm: Aua o le a oo mai le Meleniuma tele, lea na Ou fai atu ai e ala i fofoga o a’u auauna.

verses.en: For Satan shall be bound, and when he is loosed again he shall only reign for a little season, and then cometh the end of the earth.
verses.sm: Aua o le a noatia Satani, ma a toe tatalaina o ia, o le a nofotupu o ia mo nao se vaitau itiiti, ona oo mai ai lea o le iuga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And he that liveth in righteousness shall be changed in the twinkling of an eye, and the earth shall pass away so as by fire.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e ola i le amiotonu o le a liua e pei o le emo o se mata, ma o le a mavae atu le lalolagi e peiseai o se afi.

verses.en: And the wicked shall go away into unquenchable fire, and their end no man knoweth on earth, nor ever shall know, until they come before me in judgment.
verses.sm: Ma o e e amioleaga o le a o ese atu i le afi e lē matineia, ma o lo latou iuga e leai se tasi i luga o le lalolagi ua iloaina, pe na te iloaina lava, seia latou o mai i o’u luma i le faamasinoga.

verses.en: Hearken ye to these words. Behold, I am Jesus Christ, the Savior of the world. Treasure these things up in your hearts, and let the solemnities of eternity rest upon your minds.
verses.sm: Ia outou faalogo mai i nei upu. Faauta, o A’u o Iesu Keriso, o le Faaola o le lalolagi. Ia teu i o outou loto nei mea, ma ia tuu le tulaga-mamalu o le faavavau ia mau i luga o o outou mafaufau.

verses.en: Be sober. Keep all my commandments. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ia faamamalu. Tausi i au poloaiga uma. Ia faapea lava. Amene.
